scheme_name: CIPET – Central Institute of Petrochemicals Engineering CG Scheme
overview: CIPET – Central Institute of Petrochemicals Engineering & Technology is a premier autonomous institution under the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, Government of India, established in 1968 with UNDP assistance. It provides academic programs, skill development training, technology support, and research & development services for the petrochemicals and plastics industries across India. The institute operates through multiple centres including IPT, CSTS, and SARP, offering diploma, undergraduate, postgraduate, and Ph.D. programs in various engineering and technology disciplines.
objectives: Development of skilled Human Resource for petrochemicals/plastics industries.
Upgradation of technical knowledge through advanced training programmes
Quality control and standardization of plastics materials and products.
Technical consultancy and advisory services for enhancing techno-commercial competitiveness of the industries.
Design and development of moulds, dies for petrochemicals/plastics industries.
Research and Application development in the area of Petrochemicals/Plastics Engineering & Technology.
eligibility: Eligibility varies by program: For Diploma in Plastics Technology (DPT) and Diploma in Plastics Mould Technology (DPMT): Full time 10th Std. For Post Graduate Diploma in Plastics Processing & Testing (PGD-PPT): Full time 3-year Degree in Science. For Post Diploma in Plastics Mould Design with CAD/CAM: 3 year full time Diploma in Mechanical / Plastics / Polymer / Tool / Production / Mechatronics / Automobile / Tool & Die Making / Petrochemicals / Industrial / Instrumentation Engg / Technology or DPMT/DPT or Equivalent. For UG/PG Degree programs: As per norms set out by respective affiliated State Universities. No age bar for most programs.
benefits: Academic programs affiliated to State Universities, AICTE-approved engineering programs, scholarships for meritorious students (Rs.8,000–12,000 per semester based on rank), hostel facilities, placement support (80% placement rate), technology support services including testing, standardization, machinery selection, tool room setup, and technical consultancy, research opportunities at SARP centres, skill development training programs approved by NCVET, and access to industry linkages and placement networks.
financial_support: Scholarships are granted to meritorious students pursuing Diploma/Post Diploma/Post Graduate Diploma programmes. The scholarship amount is Rs.12,000/- per candidate for All India 1st Rank Holder, Rs.10,000/- per candidate for All India 2nd Rank Holder, and Rs.8,000/- per candidate for All India 3rd Rank Holder per semester based on previous semester results. The scheme targets students from three-year Diploma programmes, two-year Post Graduate Diploma, and 1.5-year Post Diploma programmes. A total of 30 candidates per semester are selected. Scholarship is disbursed directly to the CIPET Centre where the student is pursuing the programme from the interest amount earned from the fund donated by Plast India Foundation.
grant_amount_per_entity: Rs.12,000/- per candidate for All India 1st Rank Holder, Rs.10,000/- per candidate for All India 2nd Rank Holder, and Rs.8,000/- per candidate for All India 3rd Rank Holder per Semester
application_process: 1. CIPET releases admission notice in leading English and regional newspapers in February/March every year. 2. Candidates can register application through the online admission portal linked to CIPET website (www.cipet.gov.in) against payment as notified. 3. Applications can be submitted online till the last date as notified in the admission notice. 4. Admission is conducted through a CAT – Online CIPET Admission Test conducted at selected places on all India basis, likely on a Sunday in May/June/July every year. 5. Selection is based on eligibility criteria set by affiliated State Universities for UG/PG programs and as per CIPET norms for diploma programs. 6. Category-wise reservation is followed: Scheduled Caste 15%, Scheduled Tribe 7.5%, Other Backward Classes + Minority 27%, Physically Challenged 3% (horizontal), General & Others 37.5%, Economically weaker section 10%. 7. Provisional selection is cancelled if candidate does not accept the allotment within stipulated time, and wait list is operated to fill vacancies.

Application form for Retotalling of Answer Scripts
Application form for getting Photocopy of Answer Scripts
Application form for Revaluation of Answer Scripts

Application form for getting Duplicate Mark Sheet
deadlines: Admission notice released in February/March every year. Online CAT – CIPET Admission Test likely conducted on a Sunday in May/June/July every year. Exact dates announced through website or newspaper.
implementing_agency: Department of Chemicals & Petrochemicals, Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers, Government of India
contact_details: Email: academics@cipet.gov.in | Telephone No.: 044-2225 4780 / 22254514 | Head Office: Central Institute of Petrochemicals Engineering & Technology, Academic Cell, Head Office, Guindy, Chennai - 600 032.
caveats: No request for change of centre allotted for admission will be entertained during the course of study.
Provisional selection will be cancelled for candidate not accepting the allotment of admission within the stipulated time.
Students must maintain minimum 80% attendance to appear in semester examinations; less than 80% in more than 50% of subjects leads to debarment and requirement to re-appear via readmission procedure.
Scholarship will be stopped/withdrawn if progress of student is not satisfactory.
Trainees under disciplinary action are not eligible for scholarship.
Scholarship amount must be refunded if scholarship holder discontinues the course.
Hostlers must not leave the hostel without written request from parent/guardian or permission of the Warden.
Hostlers are not permitted to use extra electrical fittings in their rooms.
Meals will not be served after 10.30 p.m. under any circumstances.
Hostlers must vacate rooms during semester break; special permission for over stay will not be granted.
